summary: I dig Klobuchar for her work in the Senate, plus midwest connections, but she is coming off quite nervous, as if she knows this is last go, but doesn't have a plan. Still debate disposition won't decide it for me. #demdebate
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I dig Klobuchar for her work in the Senate, plus midwest connections, but she is coming off quite nervous, as if she knows this is last go, but doesn't have a plan. Still debate disposition won't decide it for me. #demdebate
